sections.text_helper: Section 9.8.26 "RCC APB1 sleep clock register (RCC_APB1HLPENR)" in chapter 9 (Reset and clock control (RCC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 311.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0C8
Reset value: 0x4000 0208
Bits 31:10 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 9 FDCANLPEN: FDCAN1 and FDCAN2 clock enable during Sleep mode
Set and reset by software.
0: FDCAN1 and FDCAN2 clock disabled during Sleep mode
1: FDCAN1 and FDCAN2 clock enabled during Sleep mode (default after reset)
Bits 8:4 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 3 COMPLPEN: COMP clock enable during Sleep mode
Set and reset by software.
0: COMP clock disabled during Sleep mode
1: COMP clock enabled during Sleep mode (default after reset)
Bits 2:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
